events.title: Black Mountain Work Day - Tree Clearing
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for a work day on the! No experience is necessary - our Pisgah SORBA Trail Crew Leaders will provide all tools, guidance, and instruction. Date: Saturday, November 14th from 9:00am-2:00pm Trail Work Location: Lower Black Mountain Trail Meetup Location: Black Mountain Trailhead Parking Lot Work description: Removing previously cut wood from the area TCL: Jack Duffey Required items: Long pants, boots that cover your ankles, safety glasses (can be provided), gloves (can be provided), hardhat (bike helmets DO NOT count, but climbing helmets do, also can be provided), snacks/lunch and water. All tools will be provided. Come out and give back to the trails!

events.title: 2026 Annual Meeting
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for our Annual Meeting as we vote in our 2027 Board of Directors, share updates on our projects, programs, and plans for the year ahead. We will also be hosting a panel discussion about this History of Pisgah. Come on out to connect with the local trail community and learn how we’re working together to build and maintain better trails across Western North Carolina! No RSVP is required. Date: Monday, December 7th Time: 5:30pm - 7:30pm (panel will begin at 6:30pm) Location: The Mule at Devils Foot in Asheville
events.venue: 131 Sweeten Creek Rd, Asheville, NC 28803, USA

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Conative MTB Apparel Night: Reverse Handicap
events.description: In a reverse handicap race, everyone chooses a random number at registration. Each racer takes their random number and subtracts it from their race position at the finish.

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Fox Factory Night: Best Costume
events.description: Halloween-week party. Show up in your best costume and race in it (safely!). The podium goes to the best costumes of the night. Group costumes, homemade outfits and full commitment are all welcome.
